brief.audience: People who enjoy handmade ceramics and quiet craft films
brief.purpose: Reveal the finished cup and make its hand-glazed surface feel tactile
brief.visual_style: Naturalistic macro craft cinematography, warm wood and soft left window light
brief.subject: A ceramicist revealing a finished cobalt-blue cup
required_beats: The ceramicist turns the finished cup to reveal the glaze streak
An intimate push-in lets the viewer study the finished cup
brief.audio_or_dialogue: Soft ceramic scrape and quiet studio room tone; no speech, music, captions or logos
assumptions: Only the ceramicist's right hand and oatmeal linen apron are visible; no recurring face is required
The cup has one oval handle on screen right, a round unchipped rim and one pale vertical glaze streak
The camera stays on the same side of the workbench and the key light stays screen left
Delivery is selected clips and an edit list; assemble only on request
This acceptance example is planning only and authorizes zero live generations

authorization.request: Initial build and dry-run acceptance only. Zero generations.

units.purpose: Reusable product identity reference for the finished blue cup
units.end_state: Selected reference showing the rim, handle and glaze clearly
units.framing: Full cup, three-quarter product view, uncluttered pale neutral background
acceptance: One oval handle on screen right with a single open hole
Cobalt-blue glaze with exactly one pale vertical streak facing front
No extra handles, lettering, malformed edges or clutter
units.prompt: Product identity photograph of one handmade ceramic cup. Short gently tapered cylindrical body, round unchipped rim, one oval loop handle on the right with a single open hole. Rich cobalt-blue glaze with one narrow pale cream vertical streak facing the camera and a thin unglazed clay foot. Three-quarter view showing the entire cup, rim and handle without occlusion. Soft light from the left, uncluttered pale warm-gray background. Vertical composition with generous empty space. No hands, text, logos or extra objects.

units.purpose: The ceramicist reveals the finished blue cup's signature glaze streak
units.start_state: Cup on warm wooden workbench, handle screen right; the ceramicist's right hand rests on the handle
units.end_state: Cream glaze streak faces the lens, hand has released the cup and withdrawn; cup still from second 6 onward
units.framing: Vertical close-up with entire cup, rim and handle visible; oatmeal linen apron softly out of focus behind
units.action: Right hand turns the cup a quarter turn to reveal the pale glaze streak, then releases it
units.camera: Locked close-up at rim height, same side of the workbench throughout
units.audio_cue: Soft ceramic scrape against wood and quiet room tone

references.role: Exact cup identity: silhouette, rim, oval handle, cobalt glaze and pale streak

acceptance: Cup matches A01, especially the rim, handle and streak
Only one plausible right hand; no merged fingers
One smooth quarter turn with no sliding or morphing
Cup and camera still at the 7-second cut; clean frame available there
units.prompt: Use the reference image solely for the cup's exact shape, oval handle, cobalt-blue glaze and single pale streak. Vertical locked close-up at rim height in a quiet ceramics studio. Place that finished cup on a warm wooden workbench; an oatmeal linen apron is softly blurred behind it. The ceramicist's right hand, already resting on the handle, slowly turns the cup one quarter turn until the pale streak faces the lens. The hand releases it and withdraws by second six. Hold the complete cup motionless in the same framing for the final two seconds. Keep the handle on the right and soft window light from screen left. Sound is a soft ceramic scrape against wood and quiet room tone. No dialogue or music.

units.purpose: Linger on the finished cup and its handmade surface
units.start_state: Exact clean frame at 7.000 seconds of selected S01: cup still, hand out of frame, streak facing lens
units.end_state: Closer view of the same intact cup with handle and rim remaining in frame
units.framing: Start from S01 cut boundary, then a subtle 10-percent push-in
units.action: Camera slowly moves closer while the cup remains completely still
units.camera: One gentle straight push-in, no orbit, rack focus or change of screen direction
units.audio_cue: Continuous quiet studio room tone; no speech or music

references.role: Start frame and cut continuity from the selected preceding take

acceptance: Opening matches the selected S01 frame at 7 seconds
Rim, oval handle and glaze streak remain unchanged throughout
Cup stays still; no hands re-enter
Push-in remains subtle and settles for the last second
No abrupt sound change at the cut; check by playback
units.prompt: The supplied start frame establishes the cup, studio, framing and light. Keep the cup completely still. Move the camera slowly straight forward by about ten percent over the first seven seconds, then hold for the last second. Preserve the whole rim and right-side handle inside the frame; keep the pale glaze streak facing the lens and the left window light unchanged. No orbit, no hand entering, no new objects. Sound is continuous quiet studio room tone. No speech or music.
